description: This file defines the InstallerController class within the OrangeHRM Installer module, responsible for managing the installer process' presentation logic, particularly the pre-rendering phase where it sets up the installation process screen component and updates the current screen state.

classes.name: InstallerController
classes.description: Controller responsible for managing the installer process views, extending AbstractInstallerVueController and handling pre-render logic.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the installer view by initializing the install process component and updating the current screen state.
